about: David's basement as he sketched it on Oct 30, 2026, for every take of it (david-*). The roles are what each room is; the doors are which rooms they join. Add his tape numbers under tape as {room, side: long|short, m}.

rooms.note: the main basement; plumbing for a toilet straight ahead from the stairs
small low room just to the left at the foot of the stairs; you duck to go in
beside and partly under the stairs
reached only from the main basement

doors.note: the utility room has two doors; which rooms the second joins isn't on the sketch
